description: TPC-H Text-to-SQL evaluation suite. Scale factor 0.1. Each case has an answer check (match_type) and gold_sql for execution-accuracy checks.

cases.question: How many customers are in the database?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer

cases.question: How many orders are there in total?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders

cases.question: How many line items are in the database?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lineitem

cases.question: How many suppliers are there?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM supplier

cases.question: How many distinct nations are in the database?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT n_nationkey) FROM nation

cases.question: How many distinct regions are there?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM region

cases.question: What is the total revenue (sum of extended price times (1 minus discount)) across all line items?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(l_extendedprice*(1-l_discount)) FROM lineitem

cases.question: What is the average order total price?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(o_totalprice) FROM orders

cases.question: What is the total quantity of all line items shipped?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(l_quantity) FROM lineitem

cases.question: What is the maximum account balance among all customers?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT MAX(c_acctbal) FROM customer

cases.question: How many orders have status 'F' (fulfilled)?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE o_orderstatus='F'

cases.question: How many orders have priority '1-URGENT'?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE o_orderpriority='1-URGENT'

cases.question: How many customers have a positive account balance (greater than 0)?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer WHERE c_acctbal>0

cases.question: How many line items were shipped by air (shipmode = 'AIR')?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipmode='AIR'

cases.question: How many parts have size greater than 40?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM part WHERE p_size>40

cases.question: How many customers are in the BUILDING market segment?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer WHERE c_mktsegment='BUILDING'

cases.question: Which region has the most customers? Just give the region name.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT r_name FROM customer JOIN nation ON c_nationkey=n_nationkey JOIN region ON n_regionkey=r_regionkey GROUP BY r_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: How many orders were placed by customers from GERMANY?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders JOIN customer ON o_custkey=c_custkey JOIN nation ON c_nationkey=n_nationkey WHERE n_name='GERMANY'

cases.question: What is the total revenue from orders placed by customers in the ASIA region?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(l_extendedprice*(1-l_discount)) FROM lineitem JOIN orders ON l_orderkey=o_orderkey JOIN customer ON o_custkey=c_custkey JOIN nation ON c_nationkey=n_nationkey JOIN region ON n_regionkey=r_regionkey WHERE r_name='ASIA'
SELECT SUM(o_totalprice) FROM orders JOIN customer ON o_custkey=c_custkey JOIN nation ON c_nationkey=n_nationkey JOIN region ON n_regionkey=r_regionkey WHERE r_name='ASIA'

cases.question: How many distinct parts does each supplier supply on average? Round to 1 decimal place.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(COUNT(*)*1.0/COUNT(DISTINCT ps_suppkey),1) FROM partsupp

cases.question: What are the top 3 nations by number of customers? List the nation names.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT n_name FROM customer JOIN nation ON c_nationkey=n_nationkey GROUP BY n_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3

cases.question: Which customer market segment has the highest total order value? Just give the segment name.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT c_mktsegment FROM orders JOIN customer ON o_custkey=c_custkey GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY SUM(o_totalprice) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: What ship mode has the highest average discount? Just give the ship mode name.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT l_shipmode FROM lineitem GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY AVG(l_discount) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: What is the name of the supplier with the highest account balance?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT s_name FROM supplier ORDER BY s_acctbal DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: Which order has the highest total price? Return just the order key.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT o_orderkey FROM orders ORDER BY o_totalprice DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: How many orders were placed in 1994?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE YEAR(o_orderdate)=1994

cases.question: What year had the most orders placed? Just give the year.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT YEAR(o_orderdate) FROM orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: How many line items were shipped in January 1995?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate>='1995-01-01' AND l_shipdate<'1995-02-01'

cases.question: What is the total revenue from line items shipped in 1996?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(l_extendedprice*(1-l_discount)) FROM lineitem WHERE YEAR(l_shipdate)=1996

cases.question: How many orders were placed in Q1 (January through March) of 1995?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE o_orderdate>='1995-01-01' AND o_orderdate<'1995-04-01'

cases.question: How many different order statuses exist?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o_orderstatus) FROM orders

cases.question: How many different ship modes exist?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l_shipmode) FROM lineitem

cases.question: How many parts are in each brand? How many distinct brands are there?
gold_sql: SELECT p_brand, COUNT(*) FROM part GROUP BY p_brand

cases.question: What is the total number of orders per order status? Which status has the most orders?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT o_orderstatus, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY 1

cases.question: What is the average discount rate per ship mode? Which ship mode has the lowest average discount?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT l_shipmode, AVG(l_discount) FROM lineitem GROUP BY 1

cases.question: How many customers have placed more than 20 orders?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT o_custkey FROM orders GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>20)

cases.question: What percentage of customers have never placed an order? Round to 1 decimal place.
cases.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0*COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE c_custkey NOT IN (SELECT o_custkey FROM orders))/COUNT(*),1) FROM customer

cases.question: How many parts have a retail price above the average retail price?
cases.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM part WHERE p_retailprice > (SELECT AVG(p_retailprice) FROM part)

cases.question: How many suppliers have total supply cost above the average supplier supply cost?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT SUM(ps_supplycost) t FROM partsupp GROUP BY ps_suppkey) WHERE t > (SELECT AVG(t) FROM (SELECT SUM(ps_supplycost) t FROM partsupp GROUP BY ps_suppkey))

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT SUM(ps_supplycost*ps_availqty) t FROM partsupp GROUP BY ps_suppkey) WHERE t > (SELECT AVG(t) FROM (SELECT SUM(ps_supplycost*ps_availqty) t FROM partsupp GROUP BY ps_suppkey))

cases.question: What is the total revenue lost due to discounts on line items shipped in 1995? (Revenue lost = sum of extended_price * discount)
cases.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(l_extendedprice*l_discount) FROM lineitem WHERE YEAR(l_shipdate)=1995
